sloka: उपवास कृशाम् दीनाम् निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ।ददर्श शुक्ल पक्ष आदौ चन्द्र रेखाम् इव अमलाम् ॥५-१५-१९॥
transliteration: upavāsa kṛśām dīnām nihśvasantīm punaḥ punaḥ ।dadarśa śukla pakṣa ādau candra rekhām iva amalām ॥5-15-19॥

translations.english: Then he beheld a lady surrounded by female demons. Clad in soiled clothes she looked dejected, emaciated through fasting and was sighing repeatedly. She appeared thin and pale like the crescent Moon at the beginning of the bright fortnight.
